supporting_observations.claim: The supplied Zeek connection records show WS-LMARTINS-01 making several connections to the internal proxy at 10.40.20.30:8080, including connections around 13:36, 13:41, 13:51, 13:55, 14:00, and 14:06 UTC. The records do not identify the external destinations.

The recurring timing is compatible with the inventoried PixelForge updater's roughly five-minute update-check cadence, but the available records do not establish that PixelForge generated these connections.

At 14:10 and 14:18 UTC, the workstation made SMB connections to DC-NWD-01, with corresponding network logons for the workstation machine account. These records do not show the process or purpose behind the connections.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied sensor-coverage metadata reports a collection outage for WS-LMARTINS-01 winsec and sysmon, and for the proxy sensor, from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC. This leaves the alert window without endpoint process attribution or proxy destination details.
Zeek connection records are available, but the supplied records identify the internal proxy endpoint rather than the external HTTPS destinations.
claims_not_established: The external domains or URLs contacted during the periodic connections.
Which process, account, or application initiated the connections during the outage.
Whether the connections were PixelForge update checks or another activity.
Whether any data was uploaded, downloaded, or otherwise transferred beyond the connection byte counts.
The purpose or legitimacy of the SMB connections to DC-NWD-01.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover proxy logs for 13:30–14:10 UTC, including CONNECT destinations, authenticated user, user agent, and byte counts.
Recover endpoint sysmon and winsec events for WS-LMARTINS-01 during the collection outage, especially process creation and network events.
Review PixelForge updater logs and process execution history to confirm whether pfupdater.exe ran and contacted its approved update service.
Review relevant Zeek SSL/TLS metadata and any available firewall or DNS records for the same interval.
Check endpoint and domain-controller records for the purpose of the 14:10 and 14:18 SMB connections.
